# exoscale_sks_nodepool_template (Data Source)

Fetch an Exoscale [Scalable Kubernetes Service (SKS)](https://community.exoscale.com/product/compute/containers/) Node Pool template, to pin an [exoscale_sks_nodepool](../resources/sks_nodepool.md) on it with `template_id`.

Without `name`, the latest template of the Kubernetes version and variant is returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "exoscale_sks_nodepool_template" "my_template" {
  zone         = "ch-gva-2"
  kube_version = "1.34"
  variant      = "nvidia"
}

output "my_template_id" {
  value = data.exoscale_sks_nodepool_template.my_template.id
}
```

Please refer to the [examples](https://github.com/exoscale/terraform-provider-exoscale/tree/master/examples/)
directory for complete configuration examples.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `kube_version` (String) The Kubernetes version of the node pool (`<major>.<minor>` or `<major>.<minor>.<patch>`).
- `zone` (String) The Exoscale [Zone](https://www.exoscale.com/datacenters/) name.

### Optional

- `name` (String) The SKS node pool template name to match (default: the latest template).
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `variant` (String) The template variant: `standard`, or `nvidia` for GPU instance types (default: `standard`).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The template registration date.
- `id` (String) The SKS node pool template ID.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
